description: Apply a sizing factor to zones on edges. The factor is applied to edges in the current < range >, if supplied, or on all edges if not. The factor f must be between 0.001 and 1000.0 (the default is 1.0).
notes: Requires a current building-blocks set: run 'building-blocks set create <name>' then 'building-blocks set select <name>' before any block/edge/face/point operation; otherwise FLAC rejects the command with 'Unused extra parameter'.

7.0.description: Apply a sizing factor to zones on edges. The factor is applied to edges in the current < range >, if supplied, or on all edges if not. The factor f must be between 0.001 and 1000.0 (the default is 1.0). When zones are generated from the blocks, the factor (like a ratio, see building-blocks edge ratio ) defines zone sizes of relative length along the edge block. Factor specifies a ratio of last zone length to the first zone length along an edge. When the factor for an edge is changed, the change is propagated to all face-connected opposite edges.
